# Ataraxy Revenue Engine

> Ataraxy is an applied AI agency based in Montevideo, Uruguay, serving LATAM and the US. Revenue Engine is an AI outbound system that finds best-fit accounts from buying signals, with human-reviewed messages and client ownership.

## Service

- [Revenue Engine](https://revenue.ataraxydigital.com/): An AI outbound system that finds best-fit accounts from buying signals, with human-reviewed messages and client ownership.
- [How it works](https://revenue.ataraxydigital.com/#how): The delivery process and operating model.
- [Scope and ownership](https://revenue.ataraxydigital.com/#own): What the client receives and how the engagement works.
